purpose: Negative control for the compiled-artifact completeness gate. A registration that the syntactic source scanner provably cannot see must still be caught by the artifact cross-check, and the combined gate must fail naming it.

source_change.description: Added `type ControlRow = X509V3ExtMethod;`, `macro_rules! control_row` whose body spells the row literal `ControlRow { ... }` with `i2s: Some($ptr)`, a safe `extern "C" fn callback_crosscheck_control`, `static CONTROL_ROW = control_row!(0x5FFF, callback_crosscheck_control)`, appended `&CONTROL_ROW` to STANDARD_EXTS and raised STANDARD_EXTENSION_COUNT from 73 to 74. The scanner matches the literal text `X509V3ExtMethod {`; it sees neither the aliased literal nor the callback target.
source_change.build: cargo build --release (CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=4, 20.57 s) followed by the exact libcrypto.so.3 link line from forensics/tools/build_phase2.sh; no source drift beyond the control edit

source_only_gate.observation: FAIL-OPEN. The scanner does not parse `ControlRow { ... }` (its literal regex is `X509V3ExtMethod {`), and the callback appears only as the macro argument. The control run exits 0 and its generated manifest contains zero rows, zero registrations and zero callback entries involving `callback_crosscheck_control` or `control_row`.

unaccounted_target.reason: no manifest row accounts for this row

compiled_crosscheck.observation: The compiled artifact contains the macro-expanded row and its callback at a populated i2s slot. The committed manifest has no registration for it, so the gate fails and names CONTROL_ROW / i2s / callback_crosscheck_control.

combined_gate.rule: nonzero when either the source layer or the compiled layer fails or refuses
combined_gate.observation: The combined gate fails on the registration the source-only gate provably did not see.

restore.observation: After `git checkout`, `cargo build --release` and the same relink, the artifact is byte-identical to the pre-control candidate (ececbd98...). Both layers pass again. The authoritative source-gate invocation (without the post-enrolment control inventory) still exits 1 on the pre-existing 66-missing enrolment finding; that is independent of this control.

limits: The control target is a distinct callback name; a macro-expanded row that reused an already-manifested callback name would not be detected at target level, though the registration-level check would still flag the unmatched (row, slot, target) pair.

The structural discovery of per-file static row objects uses the ext_nid/ext_flags domain of X509V3ExtMethod. A row outside that domain would be reported as an excluded non-row object rather than refused; table-referenced rows are always examined.
The control rebuild used the crate build plus the exact libcrypto link line, not the full build_phase2.sh court suite; no court result is claimed from this control.
